metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins and supporting CLIs

plugins.name: imdb
plugins.description: IMDB movie and TV data. Search films, look up cast and box office, browse Top 250 movies/shows, and check upcoming releases. Commands: /imdb, /imdb:movie, /imdb:person, /imdb:top

plugins.name: dream-team
plugins.description: Factory plugin for AI expert teams — recruit experts, materialize self-sufficient /consult-/coach-/plan-/review workflows into your repo, keep them working after plugin uninstall. Multi-IDE (Claude+Cursor+Copilot) with blueprint-integrity hooks.

plugins.name: document
plugins.description: Document type system — define document types and generate per-type management skills with lifecycle, relationships, enrichment, verification, and CRUD operations, plus a git-derived change-event log over the portfolio

plugins.name: copilot-money
plugins.description: Personal finance data from Copilot Money. Check account balances, search transactions, view budget vs actuals, track spending patterns, and analyze cash flow. Commands: /copilot-money, /copilot-money:transactions, /copilot-money:budget, /copilot-money:summary, /copilot-money:status

plugins.name: lab-intake
plugins.description: Durable knowledge intake for research-style repos: capture raw notes verbatim, distill and index them, and protect every record with write-once guards. Commands: /lab-intake:init, /lab-intake:intake

plugins.name: lab-loop
plugins.description: Hypothesis-driven experiment loop: register specs with binary pass/fail assertions, run pre-flight checks, and record mechanical keep/refine/discard verdicts in an append-only journal. Extends lab-intake. Commands: /lab-loop:init, /lab-loop:hypothesis

plugins.name: crux
plugins.description: Crux: durable repo memory, evidence-grade experiments, and an explicit operating model — one plugin, profile-gated. Write-once capture + journal + dashboard; the hypothesis loop with binary assertions and mechanical verdicts; the operating-model lifecycle (adopt/observe/evaluate/compile/verify/run). /crux:init scaffolds per profile; upgrading from lab-intake+lab-loop is a counted two-way door (docs/upgrading.md). 0.2.0 adds the environment-health doctor (typed credential-flap classification with a frozen remediation ladder) plus the verdict-forcing review cadence over open ledger rows.
